purpose: Minimal daemon/extension seam required for the final two Browser capability commands; every other canonical command uses existing raw/CDP/notification primitives.

params.hostname: string; observed by Browser JS from the same tab immediately before dispatch

invariants: The daemon validates caller ownership of tabId and stamps the existing raw-ingress provenance and logical identity.
The report is recorded at most once for the operation id; ambiguous mutation outcomes are never retried.
The returned hostname is the accepted report hostname or null when the host intentionally redacts it.

params.expires_at: RFC 3339 timestamp no more than five minutes in the future
params.fields: 1..6 entries with id, label, type, autocomplete, required, selector
params.submit: optional selector plus click | press_enter action

result.status: submitted | declined | cancelled | unavailable | expired | origin_changed | page_changed | locator_invalid | submission_failed

invariants: The daemon validates caller ownership, current tab origin, expiry, field ids, and selectors before presenting host UI.
Credential values never return through Browser JS, MCP output, logs, metadata, or the extension notification stream.
The host applies values and optional submission exactly once under the existing operation settlement fence; ambiguous mutation outcomes are never retried.
Any origin or page identity change before application returns the corresponding non-submitted status.

onCDPEvent.params: { source: { tabId, sessionId?, targetId?, extensionId? }, method: string, params?: object }
onCDPEvent.invariant: Ordered per bridge actor and delivered to every live logical connection that owns the browser.

onCDPDetach.invariant: Delivered after the final event for the detached target.

onDownloadChange.params: { id, status, filename?, path?, url?, session_id? }
onDownloadChange.invariant: Only caller-owned download state is routed; complete paths name regular same-user files.
